title: Interception/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Lotus transmissions during an Interception mission.
- Lotus: "We have located the enemy's planetary communication towers. Capture the towers and remain in control long enough to decode incoming messages."
- Lotus: "These radio towers carry top secret interplanetary communications. You are going to capture the towers and decode incoming messages."
- Lotus: "Nearby communications towers are broadcasting crucial enemy intelligence. Capture the towers and decode any incoming messages."
- Lotus: "The enemy will stop to capture this intel before we do. We cannot let that happen."

- Lotus: "The enemy has adapted to our ability to intercept there communications from space. Using these new communications towers means that messages cannot be intercepted anywhere but their destination."
- Lotus: "These towers are used for encoding two way communications between planets. The more towers we control, the faster we can intercept the message."
- Lotus: "Try and capture another signal. Be careful though, the enemy has surely rallied stronger reinforcements."
- Lotus: "I have detected another message incoming. Capture and decode the signal."
- Lotus: "They are broadcasting another message, make sure the enemy never receives it."
- Lotus: "Tower captured, beginning stream decode now."
- Lotus: "You have captured a radio tower."
- Lotus: "The enemy have captured a tower."
- Lotus: "We have lost control of a tower."
- Lotus: "The enemy have taken a tower, you must recapture it."
- Lotus: "We are in total control. Keep fighting."
- Lotus: "We have control of all four towers."
- Lotus: "We are dominating, keep it up."
- Lotus: "The enemy is dominating, you must capture a tower, and quickly."
- Lotus: "The enemy has all four towers. You must stop them."
- Lotus: "We have successfully decoded the message. Clear the area."
- Lotus: "We have the decoded the message. The remaining enemies must not report back to their command. Eliminate everyone."
- Lotus: "Message decoded. Leave none alive. Clear out the remaining enemy forces."
- Lotus: "We cannot allow the enemy to learn of our espionage. Eliminate the remaining enemy personnel."
- Lotus: "The enemy have deployed fierce reinforcements, are you willing to stay and decode more messages?"
- Lotus: "More data is being broadcasted, are you willing to risk going back into the field?"
- Lotus: "Extraction is available but there are more messages to be decoded. Will you stay or go?"
- Lotus: "The data you have collected here today will go a long way in supporting our cause."
- Lotus: "Good work today. Not only have we decoded the enemy transmissions, we have also disrupted their communications."
- Lotus: "The enemy have captured the message. We have failed today."
- Lotus: "The enemy have decoded the message. You have failed in your mission."
- Lotus: "We need to find out where the Fomorian power cores are being produced. Intercept Grineer messages so that we may determine the facility's location."
- Lotus: "You are here to intercept critical information about the Grineer Fomorian power cores."
- Lotus: "The Grineer are communicating using a highly sophisicated deep encryption algorithm. We can crack it, but we need as many message fragments as possible."
- Lotus: "The message fragments you collected here today will go a long way to locating the Fomorian cores."
